slide: Payments that wait for the deal.
text: Hi, I'm Shan, and this is Holdback. Software sells one way today: a subscription. One price, take it or leave it. Real markets never worked like that. You bargain. Students get a discount. Businesses buy in bulk. Now that agents can negotiate for us, pricing can be that flexible again.
The catch: on-chain, a payment is final. A losing bid is already gone, and there's no money back when something's wrong. Cards fixed this with authorize and capture, but only for big merchants.

slide: Hold, capture what's fair, refund the rest.
text: Holdback is auth-capture for Solana. The buyer's money goes into a hold. The seller captures only what the deal says, and the rest goes back automatically.

slide: Every pricing model is a capture rule.
text: Once you have holds, every pricing model is just a rule: a money-back guarantee, pay-if-useful, offers, an auction, a falling price, affiliate splits.

slide: A seller agent picks how to sell.
text: It works for people and agents. A seller agent picks how to sell from demand: one buyer means offers, three means an auction, nobody means the price falls. Buyers, a person on the page or Claude over MCP, bargain within their limits.

slide: The agent negotiates. The contract enforces.
text: The agent negotiates; the contract enforces. A sale below the seller's floor reverts on-chain, and the buyer's limit is checked before any money moves.
In the demo, Ada bid up to 120 and paid 96, the second price plus one. Claude bargained four rounds and bought at 83.
I run Auspice, a live product with paying customers. Its pricing research led here: people pay more when they can get their money back. Before this I built Project Sienna, agent payments on Solana.
It runs on Solana, the same escrow is live on Robinhood Chain testnet, and Tempo is next. After that: presets for bulk and business deals, and an on-chain auction book.

slide: Every pricing mechanism is just how much to capture.
text: Subscriptions were one way to pay. Holdback makes all the others possible. Thank you.
